description: GP surrogates of the 25-run patterned-wafer DOE (figures/doe_results.csv), fitted by analysis/doe_gp.py with scikit-learn. Each response = OLS linear mean on the coded factors + GP(ARD RBF + white noise) on the residuals. Evaluate with aldconf.surrogate or in JavaScript.

coding.inverse: c = 2*log(v/lo)/log(hi/lo) - 1 for x, Q, p; c_g = (g_mm - 10)/7.5 - 1

responses.name: log10_t90_worst

kernel.type: ConstantKernel*RBF(ARD) + WhiteKernel on the OLS residuals

y_normalisation.note: GP fitted to residuals r = y - linear; sklearn normalize_y: r_n = (r - mean)/std

responses.prediction: y = linear(c) + mean + std * sum_j alpha_j * const*exp(-0.5*sum_k ((c_k - X_jk)/ls_k)^2); var = std^2 * (const + noise - k*^T K_inv k*)
